human_check_steps:
1. Choose Tatakikun and open TextEdit.
2. Type `maru`: ○ is 4th in the bar; ↓ shows ◯ ● ◎ ⚪ ⚫ ⭕ first in the next row.
3. Type `batsu` (and `batu`): × in the bar, ✕ ✖ ☓ ✗ ✘ ❌ below.
4. Try `sankaku`, `yajirushi`, `ha-to`, `dui`, `yuan`, `circle`, `check`: each gives its symbols, while the usual words (三角, 矢印, 对, 元, circle) stay first.
5. The full list is in the task's card (tasks/A02-town861/card.md); say which names or symbols to add or drop.
title: Typing a symbol's name gives the symbols as candidates: maru → ○ ◎ ●, batu → × ✕, and the same in every language (yuan, circle, cruz…)
without_human_check: Installed on this Mac; the symbol list and typing in a real app need a person
